caption: Ancient Theater, Dodona
composition: Limestone cavea and retaining walls · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the southeast, the huge limestone cavea of the theater of Dodona faces the view, held at both ends by tall retaining walls with buttress towers. The orchestra and the low stage ruins sit in front, with oaks and low sanctuary foundations to one side. The sky is clear, about 9.6°C. The sun is still below the horizon. The theater is unlit.
